historical_event.name: Discovery of the lost 'golden city' of Aten
historical_event.description: Egyptian archaeologists announce the discovery of a 3,000-year-old ancient city near Luxor, considered the most important find since Tutankhamun's tomb.

techmeme.headline: Anthropic announces Project Glasswing, a cybersecurity initiative that will use its Claude Mythos Preview model to help find and fix software vulnerabilities
techmeme.context: Today we're announcing Project Glasswing, a new initiative that brings together Amazon Web Services, Anthropic, Apple, Apple, Broadcom…

techmeme.headline: Anthropic says Mythos Preview is a general-purpose model and found thousands of high-severity vulnerabilities, including some in every major OS and web browser
techmeme.context: Earlier today we announced Claude Mythos Preview, a new general-purpose language model. This model performs strongly across the board…

techmeme.headline: Mythos Preview system card: the model was able to escape a sandbox after it was instructed to try, and posted details about its exploit without being prompted
techmeme.context: Anthropic said its next-generation AI model is too powerful for the public. That's why Claude Mythos won't be publicly released, Anthropic said.

science_daily.headline: This Hidden State of Water Could Explain Why Life Exists
science_daily.summary: Scientists have finally found a hidden 'critical point' in supercooled water that explains why it behaves so strangely. At this point, two different liquid forms of water merge, triggering powerful fluctuations that affect water even at normal temperatures.

bigthink.headline: Why modern physics is forcing us to rethink existence
bigthink.relevance: Examina cómo el entrelazamiento cuántico podría ser la base del espacio-tiempo, desafiando nuestra comprensión fundamental de la realidad.
